copyright: Copyright (c) 2006-2015, Rational Discovery LLC, Greg Landrum, and Julie Penzotti and others
components.evidence: Provenance: node_modules/@rdkit/rdkit/dist/RDKit_minimal.wasm and node_modules/@rdkit/rdkit/dist/RDKit_minimal.js are byte-identical to dist/ in the npm tarball https://registry.npmjs.org/@rdkit/rdkit/-/rdkit-2026.9.1.tgz, whose sha512 (nbdi5yEw...xjzEA==) equals package-lock.json's integrity and the subject of the npm SLSA provenance (https://registry.npmjs.org/-/npm/v1/attestations/@rdkit%2frdkit@2026.9.1): workflow .github/workflows/minimallib-publish.yml at refs/tags/Release_2026_09_1, gitCommit fece8caa860bdf6c9c82bdb9253f22a0cf87150c, run https://github.com/rdkit/rdkit/actions/runs/37104484827 (job 111150237761, 2026-10-03; its log prints the same integrity). The attestation signature itself was not verified cryptographically. Offsets below are byte offsets in the .wasm file; "memory" addresses are in the linear memory rebuilt from the wasm's 1395 active data segments. RDKit source paths compiled into assertion strings, e.g. "/src/rdkit/Code/GraphMol/MolDraw2D/MolDraw2DSVG.cpp" at offset 6608282 and "/src/rdkit/Code/GraphMol/MolAlign/AlignMolecules.cpp" at 6604327. The build ran Code/MinimalLib/docker/03_build.Dockerfile ("make -j2 RDKit_minimal", log line 18797 "Linking CXX executable RDKit_minimal.js"). The same licence.txt is already embedded as data in web/src/chem/rdkitTables.json (sha256 daeb8d19...), but not shown to users. Inside RDKit's tree and covered by its licence: the Bison 3.8.2 parser skeleton in the generated SMILES/SMARTS parsers (Code/GraphMol/SmilesParse/smiles.tab.cpp.cmake carries the Bison special exception allowing distribution "under terms of your choice"), the superatom table adapted from openbabel/superatoms (Code/GraphMol/Abbreviations/AbbreviationsUtils.cpp line 36; that repo is Unlicense per the GitHub API), and RDKit's copy of boost hash (Code/RDGeneral/hash, BSL-1.0, see the Boost entry). RDKit origins not traced, each claimed by RDKit's headers only under RDKit's licence: Conrec (Paul Bourke; Code/Numerics/Conrec.h, used by MolDraw2DUtils.cpp), the Daylight a2b code, the Stack Overflow endian snippet (Code/RDGeneral/StreamOps.h line 25-26), PNGParser.cpp's "details of how to handle the PNG file taken from OpenBabel's PNG handling code" (wording suggests format details, not code), the Helvetica AFM widths and the BODR data. vflib-2.0 (vf2.hpp) and MolVS (Tautomer.cpp) have their own entries.

components.name: VFLib graph matching library (pieces modified into RDKit's Code/GraphMol/Substruct/vf2.hpp)
components.version: vflib-2.0 (the distribution was VFLib 2.0.6 from 2003 on, per its README); modified by Greg Landrum for RDKit from April 2009
components.licence: VFLib 2.0 licence: MIT-style, with two added conditions (a prominent notice of modifications stating how, when and by whom; and the standard distribution's source included or where to obtain it)
copyright:
Copyright (c) 2001 by
Dipartimento di Informatica e Sistemistica
Università degli studi di Napoli ``Federico II''
components.statement: RDKit's Code/GraphMol/Substruct/vf2.hpp is, in its own words, "an extensive modification by Greg Landrum of pieces from several files in the vflib-2.0 distribution", first completed in April 2009 and changed in RDKit since. The standard VFLib 2.0.6 distribution was published at http://amalfi.dis.unina.it/graph/db/vflib-2.0/vflib2.tgz, which is no longer online; an archived copy is at https://web.archive.org/web/20060511113454/http://amalfi.dis.unina.it/graph/db/vflib-2.0/vflib2.tgz.
components.evidence:
Added by the checker; the statement is our wording and needs Jeff's review. vf2.hpp at the RDKit commit (sha256 14470d6efbd7fe17de3ab1b43d77dbd8edd59eae6b170ce3f006db4a94b20517) lines 1-11: "This is an extensive modification by Greg Landrum of pieces from several files in the vflib-2.0 distribution ... The initial version of the modifications was completed in April 2009 ... the original author of the vflib files is: Author: P. Foggia http://amalfi.dis.unina.it/graph/db/vflib-2.0/doc/vflib.html". SubstructMatch.cpp line 34 #includes vf2.hpp and calls boost::vf2_all (lines 525, 564, 673); the wasm holds "/src/rdkit/Code/GraphMol/Substruct/SubstructMatch.cpp" at offset 6606778. The original site is gone; the terms come from the standard distribution itself: vflib2.tgz as captured by the Internet Archive on 2006-05-11 (http://web.archive.org/web/20060511113454id_/http://amalfi.dis.unina.it/graph/db/vflib-2.0/vflib2.tgz, sha256 851d260ef72ee62b3e589f4238a5ef25d51c66cc1f13156a7ee75e0319e0ee3e; its SHA-1 equals the archive's CDX digest 5I5MEIHKZ44QNFHCQTKS7MV5VZCCILCP, the same digest as the 2003-06 and 2006-02 captures). Its README says "This is VFLIB, version 2.0.6."; its doc/vflib-2.html is byte-identical to the site's own page as captured on 2009-02-17 (the URL above, served raw via id_), and doc/vflib.sgml carries the same terms. The saved text is lines 15-49 of that page (the section, through the disclaimer), HTML markup kept; in the copyright entry the
tags are dropped and "Università" is written "Università". The terms ask for the copyright and permission notice with the disclaimers in all copies or substantial portions, a prominent notice in the documentation of how, when and by whom the software was modified, and either the standard distribution's full source or instructions on where to obtain it; the statement is meant to meet the last two. The URL is a Wayback capture pinned by timestamp, not a git commit. MiviaLab/vf2lib on GitHub (2019, LGPL) is a later release by the same group and is not what RDKit took in 2009.

The build log compiles src/bdf/bdf.c, src/pcf/pcf.c, src/gzip/ftgzip.c, src/lzw/ftlzw.c, src/psaux/psaux.c and src/winfonts/winfnt.c; the wasm holds the module names "bsdf", "bdf", "pcf" at offsets 6621735-6621744, "STARTFONT" (BDF) at 6663534 and "FREETYPE_PROPERTIES" at 6664167. components.name: dlmalloc (Doug Lea's malloc)
components.statement: Public domain; credited as a courtesy.
components.evidence: src/settings.js at 6.0.11 sets MALLOC = "dlmalloc" by default and the RDKit build passes no -sMALLOC; get_libs_to_link adds libmalloc, built from dlmalloc.c for that setting. The text is lines 51-60 of dlmalloc.c (the dedication and version), saved verbatim. The glue calls the wasm export emscripten_builtin_memalign, which dlmalloc.c line 6087 defines as an alias of dlmemalign; the binary has no names section, so the allocator rests on the default setting.
